statement: E5 is descriptive and observational. It does not show that the plan selects superior alliances or that following it causes better playoff outcomes. Regret is measured under AS-1's own valuation.
spec: docs/P11-RecommendationIntelligence.md section 20 (E5) and section 17 (P11A-DM2); the spec is PROPOSED and unchanged
registration: Write-once: a human fills every decision below, sets status to 'registered', and writes .agent/phase11/decisions/P11A_E5_REGISTRATION_<date>.md naming this file's sha256. The harness refuses any other state. Nothing has been run on real data.

decisions_required.question: Which 2024-2026 split is used, given that PX-1b's final fit used 2024-2026
decisions_required.proposed_default: All of 2024-2026 as E5's population (E5 fits nothing and has no pass criterion; it only describes), with the 2027 holdout untouched

decisions_required.question: Reviewed and approved season scoring configurations for 2024, 2025 and 2026, registered in data/season_scoring (and the approved P5-M8 GameSpecs they reference)
decisions_required.proposed_default: none: a human enters and reviews them; without them every event is not_evaluable

decisions_required.question: The as_of rule
decisions_required.proposed_default: selection_moment: one minute after the latest scheduled qualification match (ml.playoffs.service.event_selection_moment, the P6-M7/P11-FB1 rule). The snapshot cutoff also requires each result to have been posted before as_of, so a final match that ran late is excluded and counted; the alternative (as_of = latest result time + 1 minute) must be chosen here, not after seeing results

decisions_required.question: The frozen event sample
decisions_required.proposed_default: Seeded stratified sample, seed 20261106, 2 events per season x stratum, drawn with --draw-sample (reads no outcome) and pasted into runs before registration. Strata come from each event's current TBA raw event payload (event_type_string), not events.event_type (never populated): championship_division = exactly 'Championship Division' (World Championship divisions only; a 'District Championship Division' is an ordinary event); every other event is small or large, split at the season's median team count taken without the World divisions. An event with no TBA event type is reported as unclassified and left out of the sample.

decisions_required.question: Baseline set
decisions_required.proposed_default: individual_epa (raw EPA ordering at as_of), p5_m4 (the pinned P5-M4 ordering; equals raw EPA when none is pinned, recorded), p11_fb1 (P5-M4 under the record's exclusions per turn)

population.excluded: 2027 (holdout for PX-1b and P6-M10b): never read, inspected or tuned on
population.event_requirement: at least two seeded TBA alliances; the approved P6-M1 ruleset (else the event is reported, not imputed)

per_pick: regret = V(plan top) - V(actual pick) under AS-1
actual pick's rank in the plan
per baseline: V(plan top) - V(baseline top), and whether the baseline chose the actual pick
summary: means with event-cluster bootstrap 95% intervals, per stage (first pick, later picks)
Spearman(alliance mean regret, playoff win share) with event bootstrap 95% interval, labelled observational

pass_criteria: none: E5 is descriptive (spec section 17, DM2); no result is a pass or fail, and none may be described as evidence of better outcomes
runtime: Each run is independently executable, stops at its budget (<= 45 minutes) and reports partial results; the three are reported separately, never as one verification
safety: Read-only session on an isolated stratai_test copy only (scripts.phase6_common.isolated_database); the serving database is refused
